name: Escapes Containment
description: You've developed an uncanny ability to escape from various forms of containment and dangerous situations.
connectionOptions: You helped one PC escape from a containment zone.
One PC is tracking you, believing you might be anomalous.
You have information about an anomaly that one PC is investigating.
One PC's relative was a guard you outwitted during an escape.

abilities.name: Improvisational Escape
abilities.description: You're trained in escaping from physical restraints and locked rooms.

abilities.name: Scavenger
abilities.description: You can fashion a simple tool from available materials as an action once per day.

abilities.name: Evasion Tactics
abilities.description: You're trained in stealth and escaping pursuit.

abilities.name: Anomaly Exploitation
abilities.description: You can attempt to use nearby anomalous effects to aid your escape. This is usually a difficult Intellect task.

abilities.name: Master of Disguise
abilities.description: You can create a convincing disguise in minutes, trained in deception while disguised.

abilities.name: Reality Slip
abilities.description: Once per day, you can attempt to briefly phase through a solid barrier. This is an Intellect task.

abilities.name: Great Escape
abilities.description: Once per session, you can automatically succeed on any single task related to escaping or evading capture.
